summary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The subject is unmoved at eae140e7..., mode 0444, measured identically at open and at close. All seven draft-cited digests reproduce against live bytes (v2, both Stage A verdicts, COORD, file 08, HEAD, frozen v1), and independently all 22 file-backed entries of v2.recordedInputs reproduce with zero mismatches while its HEAD entry equals live HEAD. Both occupancy verdicts are mode 0444, both are ACCEPT 0/0, and both attest that they did not read the other reviewer. Every live-register equality the subject asserts holds: required-now 28 of 28, owners 32 of 32, last gate row DR-G32, DR-G22 token OPEN, DR-126 OPEN, file 08 carries G22 under D-086, condition 2 at 4 of 32, condition 4 MET. v2's top-level head, recordedInputs.HEAD, file08Pin and requiredNowUnchanged each equal the live values. The lineage claims hold on measurement: g22-leftover-join.v3 and platform-tcb-leftover-join.v6 are the highest versions on disk and were recorded at D-197 and D-185 respectively; v3's measured leftoverDesign-true set is exactly [OBL-G22-FX-AUTHORING], so the bracket in the subject is precise and ascribes no DR-126 remainder, while v6's set [OBL-G22-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-RESERVED-TABLES] is neither claimed nor absorbed; OBL-G22-INPUT-CORPUS rests on g22-input-corpus.v2 with v1 superseded. The frozen-v1 charges are true as written: v1 pins required-now 26, HEAD 5d5d778 and file 08 3a9442d1, and carries a leftoverNameNote that no leftover-join existed. The subject marks nothing SATISFIED, SATISFIES neither DR-126 nor DR-117, opens no Class A, records no Class B SATISFIED, pins no QUALIFIED, records frozen v1 as no current remasurement, closes no leftover-design of OBL-G22-FX-AUTHORING, steals neither v6 leftoverDesign nor OBL-RESERVED-TABLES, populates no reserved TCB table, invents no Rosetta, applies no platform-tcb-contract.v45, invents no fixture bytes and no D9 code, edits neither file 08 nor COORD, adds no DR-G* row, leaves live required-now at 28, names all fifty-two of D-167 through D-218 in order including D-168, does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/, and correctly declines to claim that D-056 gates 2 and 3 do not hold. On the honesty axis the subject names zero Stage A identifiers and asserts zero advisories for both reviewers, which is exactly what both returned; unlike D-216 and D-218, this cycle's Claude Stage A carries no observationsNotFindings field, so no unlabeled-observation disclosure is owed. Thirty-four attacks were run and none landed. Nothing is charged.
